newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Gnomon to up equity capital by 1.44bln drs.
newsitem.headline: Greek Gnomon to up equity capital by 1.44bln drs.

text.p: Greek construction firm Gnomon got shareholder approval on Wednesday for a 1.44 billion drachma rights issue, the company said in a statement.
Gnomon will issue 1.8 million new common registered shares at 800 drachmas each.
The terms will be three new shares per 10 outstanding.
Proceeds will be used to acquire equipment for its Acheloos dam project, finance the Gouvia marina BOT project and retire debt, it said.
Management said it added four projects worth 6.5 billion drachmas to its backlog over the first quarter of 1997, raising the uncompleted portion of its order book to 14.5 billion.
1996 pre-tax earnings were down 33 percent to 735 million drachmas. Turnover fell 16 percent to 5.563 billion drachmas.
On a consolidated basis, pretax earnings after minority rights were off 14 percent to 956 million drachmas in 1996 on turnover growth of six percent to 7.142 million drachmas.
Gnomon's shares gained 20 drachmas to 980 on Wednesday on volume of 24,460 shares.
